questions.stem: Brewer X reports sales of $13.5bn, then deducts excise taxes of $2.5bn to show net sales of $11.0bn. Brewer Y reports revenue of $56bn, having deducted excise taxes before the top line (disclosed only in the notes). Y's revenue is most comparable to X's:
questions.explanation: Y's 'revenue' is already net of excise taxes, so it matches X's NET sales, not X's gross sales. Comparable amounts require reading the notes and MD&A — labels alone mislead.
questions.kr: Y의 'revenue'는 이미 소비세 차감 후 → X의 '순매출(net sales)'과 비교 가능. 라벨만 보면 오해 — 주석·MD&A 확인 필요.

questions.stem: A company reports one 'depreciation' line that combines depreciation on factory equipment and on head-office buildings. Its expenses are most likely grouped by:
questions.explanation: BY NATURE pools expenses by what they ARE (all depreciation together). BY FUNCTION pools by what they are FOR (e.g. cost of goods sold including factory depreciation, labour, materials).
questions.kr: 성격별(nature) = 무엇인지로 묶음(감가상각 전부 한 줄). 기능별(function) = 무엇을 위한 것인지로 묶음(예: 공장 감가상각·노무비·재료비를 포함한 매출원가).

questions.stem: An income statement that does not present a gross profit subtotal is best described as:
questions.explanation: Multi-step = shows a GROSS PROFIT subtotal. Single-step = no gross profit line (other subtotals like operating income may still appear — Danone is single-step).
questions.kr: 다단계 = 매출총이익 소계가 있음. 단일단계 = 매출총이익 줄 없음(영업이익 등 다른 소계는 있을 수 있음 — Danone).

questions.stem: A company sells land with a carrying value of 800 for 950. The land originally cost 600. The gain on disposal is closest to:
questions.explanation: Gain = proceeds − CARRYING value = 950 − 800 = 150. Choice A uses original cost (950 − 600); choice C is the proceeds.
questions.kr: 처분이익 = 처분대가 − '장부금액' = 950 − 800 = 150. A는 취득원가 사용(950 − 600), C는 처분대가 그대로.

questions.stem: Operating profit and EBIT are most likely to differ when a company reports, between operating income and net income:

choices.C: its share of the results of associates

questions.explanation: EBIT = earnings before interest and taxes, so interest and tax alone don't separate the two. Items such as share of associates' results or discontinued operations also sit between operating income and net income — so operating profit is NOT necessarily EBIT.
questions.kr: EBIT = 이자·세금 전 이익이므로 이자·세금만으로는 둘이 갈리지 않음. 관계기업 지분손익·중단영업 같은 항목이 영업이익과 순이익 사이에 있어서 영업이익 ≠ EBIT가 될 수 있음.

questions.stem: For a bank, interest expense is most likely:

choices.B: deducted as an operating expense in arriving at operating profit

questions.explanation: For financial companies interest expense relates to OPERATING activities, so it is subtracted in arriving at operating profit. For non-financial companies operating profit is before interest.
questions.kr: 금융회사의 이자비용은 '영업'활동 관련 → 영업이익 계산 시 차감. 비금융회사의 영업이익은 이자 전.

questions.stem: A company's fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest 31 December, so it occasionally reports a 53-week year. The extra week is most likely material for:

choices.B: the quarter containing the extra week
choices.C: neither, since it is adjusted out

questions.explanation: One extra week is small against 52 but large against a 13-week quarter. Analysts should check for it in historical comparisons and forecasts.
questions.kr: 52주 대비 1주는 작지만 13주 분기 대비는 큼. 과거 비교·예측 시 확인 필요.

questions.stem: Under the converged revenue standard, the step that governs the TIMING of revenue recognition is:

choices.B: allocating the price to performance obligations
choices.C: recognizing revenue when a performance obligation is satisfied

questions.explanation: Contract → Obligations → Price → Allocate → Recognize. Steps 3–4 set the AMOUNT; step 5 (satisfaction of the obligation) sets the TIMING.
questions.kr: 계약 → 수행의무 → 거래가격 → 배분 → 인식. 3–4단계 = '금액', 5단계(수행의무 이행) = '시점'.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, a contract exists only if collectability is 'probable', which means:
questions.explanation: IFRS 'probable' = MORE LIKELY THAN NOT (>50%). US GAAP 'probable' = LIKELY TO OCCUR (higher bar). Same word, different threshold → similar contracts can be treated differently.
questions.kr: IFRS의 'probable' = 50% 초과(more likely than not). US GAAP = 'likely to occur'(더 높은 기준). 같은 단어, 다른 기준.

questions.stem: A contract has a transaction price of $2.4m and expected total costs of $1.8m. Costs of $900,000 are incurred in year 1. Using an input (cost-to-cost) method, year-1 revenue is closest to:
questions.explanation: Progress = 900k / 1.8m = 50%. Revenue = 50% × 2.4m = $1.2m. Choice A books the COST as revenue — progress is measured on costs but applied to the PRICE.
questions.kr: 진행률 = 900k/1.8m = 50%. 수익 = 50% × 2.4m = 1.2m. A는 '원가'를 수익으로 인식 — 진행률은 원가로 재고, 거래'가격'에 곱함.

questions.stem: A contractor recognized $800,000 of revenue in year 1. In year 2 the contract is modified (not a new contract): the price becomes $2.3m and expected total costs $2.5m, with $1.2m incurred to date. The cumulative catch-up adjustment is closest to:
questions.explanation: Progress = 1.2 / 2.5 = 48% (NEW total costs). Cumulative revenue = 48% × 2.3m = $1,104,000. Catch-up = 1,104,000 − 800,000 already recognized = $304,000, booked at once. Choice B stops at cumulative revenue.

questions.stem: A builder with little experience in a contract type is entitled to a completion bonus, but completion depends on weather and permits. It should most likely:

choices.A: recognize the bonus in proportion to progress
choices.B: exclude the bonus until it can conclude the revenue will not be reversed
choices.C: recognize the full bonus at inception

questions.explanation: Variable consideration is included only if the company can conclude cumulative revenue will NOT have to be reversed. Limited experience + factors outside its control → exclude for now (Builder Co.).
questions.kr: 변동대가는 누적수익이 '환입되지 않을 것'이라 결론 낼 수 있을 때만 포함. 경험 부족 + 통제 밖 요인 → 지금은 제외(Builder Co.).

questions.stem: A website sells goods for suppliers who ship directly; it bears no inventory or credit risk, does not set prices, and keeps a 10% commission. On $500,000 of sales it reports revenue of:
questions.explanation: All four agent tests met (not primarily responsible, no inventory risk, no credit risk, no price discretion) → AGENT → report NET = the commission = 10% × 500,000 = $50,000.
questions.kr: 대리인 요건 4개 충족(주된 책임 없음·재고위험 없음·신용위험 없음·가격결정권 없음) → '대리인' → 순액(수수료) = 10% × 500,000 = 50,000.

questions.stem: A seller has satisfied all performance obligations except receipt of payment. It should present:
questions.explanation: RECEIVABLE = everything done except payment. CONTRACT ASSET = revenue recognized but obligations remain. CONTRACT LIABILITY = cash received before delivery.
questions.kr: 수취채권 = 대금 수령만 남음. 계약자산 = 수익은 인식했지만 의무가 남음. 계약부채 = 인도 전에 현금 수령.

questions.stem: A good or service is distinct if the customer can benefit from it on its own or with readily available resources AND:

choices.A: it is delivered at a point in time
choices.B: the promise to transfer it is separately identifiable from other promises in the contract
choices.C: its price exceeds a materiality threshold

questions.explanation: Both criteria are required: (1) benefit on its own / with readily available resources, and (2) separately identifiable. Builder Co.'s trades fail (2) — they are integrated into one building, so it's a single obligation.
questions.kr: 두 기준 모두 필요: (1) 단독 또는 쉽게 구할 수 있는 자원과 함께 효익, (2) 계약 내 다른 약속과 '구별 가능'. Builder Co.는 (2) 실패 — 하나의 건물로 통합되므로 단일 수행의무.

questions.stem: A company that previously expensed incremental costs of obtaining contracts must now capitalize them. All else equal, its reported profitability will initially:
questions.explanation: Capitalizing moves the cost to the balance sheet → less expense now → HIGHER initial profit. The cost is recognized later.
questions.kr: 자본화 → 비용이 재무상태표로 이동 → 지금 비용 감소 → 초기 이익 '증가'. 비용은 나중에 인식.

questions.stem: Recognizing a loss on a receivable only when the customer actually defaults is best described as the:
questions.explanation: Direct write-off = wait for default, then recognize the loss — 'usually not consistent with GAAP' because the loss lands in a later period than the sale. Matching requires an estimate at the time of sale.
questions.kr: 직접상각법 = 부도 시점에 손실 인식 — 손실이 매출보다 늦은 기간에 잡혀 '보통 GAAP과 불일치'. 대응원칙은 매출 시점에 추정 요구.

questions.stem: Under the matching principle, the estimate of uncollectible receivables is recorded as:

choices.B: an expense on the income statement

questions.explanation: The estimate is an EXPENSE on the income statement — not a direct reduction of revenue. It is based on experience (% of sales, % of receivables, or % overdue).
questions.kr: 추정액은 손익계산서의 '비용' — 수익 직접 차감이 아님. 경험(매출의 %, 채권의 %, 연체채권의 %)에 근거.

questions.stem: Under the matching principle, warranty expense should be recognized:

choices.B: in the period of sale as an estimate, adjusted later for actual experience
choices.C: at the end of the warranty period

questions.explanation: Estimate at sale, expense in the period of sale, then ADJUST over the warranty life as actual experience comes in. Choice A fails matching.
questions.kr: 판매 시 추정 → 판매 기간에 비용 인식 → 보증기간 동안 실제 경험으로 '조정'. A는 대응원칙 위반.

questions.stem: Estimates of uncollectible accounts are most likely based on:
questions.explanation: The estimate rests primarily on PAST EXPERIENCE, expressed as a % of sales, of receivables, or of receivables overdue.
questions.kr: 추정은 주로 '과거 경험'에 근거 — 매출·채권·연체채권의 %로 표현.

questions.stem: Equipment costs 50,000, has an estimated residual value of 5,000 and an 8-year useful life. Straight-line annual depreciation is closest to:
questions.explanation: SL = (Cost − Residual) / Life = (50,000 − 5,000) / 8 = 5,625. Choice A ignores the residual value.
questions.kr: 정액법 = (취득원가 − 잔존가치)/내용연수 = 45,000/8 = 5,625. A는 잔존가치 무시.

questions.stem: Equipment costs 20,000 with a residual value of 2,000 and a 4-year life. Under double-declining balance, year-2 depreciation is closest to:
questions.explanation: Rate = 2 × (1/4) = 50%, applied to NBV (residual NOT subtracted). Year 1: 50% × 20,000 = 10,000 → NBV 10,000. Year 2: 50% × 10,000 = 5,000 (NBV 5,000 > 2,000 floor, so no cap). Choice A applies the rate to cost − residual.

questions.stem: Under the diminishing balance method, depreciation stops when:

choices.B: net book value reaches the residual value
choices.C: accumulated depreciation equals half the cost

questions.explanation: Residual value is a FLOOR: the final year's charge is capped so that NBV ends exactly at residual value.
questions.kr: 잔존가치는 '하한': 마지막 해 상각액은 NBV가 잔존가치에서 멈추도록 제한.

questions.stem: The revaluation model for property, plant, and equipment is:

choices.A: permitted under IFRS but not US GAAP
choices.B: permitted under US GAAP but not IFRS

questions.explanation: IFRS: cost OR revaluation model. US GAAP: cost model only. (The other two differences: IFRS requires component depreciation and an annual review of residual value and useful life.)
questions.kr: IFRS: 원가모형 또는 재평가모형. US GAAP: 원가모형만. (나머지 차이: IFRS는 구성요소별 감가상각·잔존가치/내용연수 연차 검토 요구.)

questions.stem: Compared with straight-line, an accelerated depreciation method most likely results in:

choices.A: higher net income in early years
choices.B: lower net income in early years
choices.C: higher total depreciation over the asset's life

questions.explanation: Accelerated = more expense early → LOWER early net income (conservative), higher later; total depreciation over the life is the SAME.
questions.kr: 가속상각 = 초기 비용 ↑ → 초기 순이익 '감소'(보수적), 후기 증가; 전체 기간 총 상각액은 '동일'.

questions.stem: Holding cost and useful life constant, an increase in estimated residual value will most likely:

choices.C: have no effect on net income

questions.explanation: Higher residual → smaller depreciable base (cost − residual) → LOWER expense → HIGHER net income. Longer life works the same way.
questions.kr: 잔존가치 ↑ → 상각대상액(원가 − 잔존가치) ↓ → 비용 '감소' → 순이익 증가. 내용연수 연장도 같은 방향.

questions.stem: Which of the following is LEAST likely to be depreciated or amortised?

choices.A: A patent with a set expiration date

questions.explanation: Least-likely stem → T/F each. Patent (finite life) → amortised (T). Equipment → depreciated (T). Goodwill → NOT amortised; tested at least annually for impairment (F → answer).
questions.kr: least likely 지문 → 선지별 T/F. 특허(유한) → 상각(T). 설비 → 감가상각(T). 영업권 → 상각 안 함, 매년 손상검사(F → 정답).

questions.stem: Depreciating each significant component of an asset separately is:
questions.explanation: Component depreciation is REQUIRED under IFRS and not required under US GAAP.
questions.kr: 구성요소별 감가상각: IFRS '요구', US GAAP 요구하지 않음.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, dividends paid are classified in the cash flow statement as:
questions.explanation: US GAAP: interest received, dividends received and interest PAID are all operating; dividends PAID is the one exception → FINANCING.
questions.kr: US GAAP: 이자수취·배당수취·이자'지급' 모두 영업; 배당'지급'만 예외 → '재무'.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, interest paid is classified in the cash flow statement as:
questions.explanation: Under US GAAP interest paid is OPERATING (it flows through net income). Putting it in financing is the common swap — only dividends paid is financing.
questions.kr: US GAAP에서 이자지급 = '영업'(순이익을 거침). 재무로 넣는 것이 흔한 실수 — 재무는 배당지급뿐.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, interest received may be classified in the cash flow statement as:
questions.explanation: IFRS gives a choice: items RECEIVED → operating or investing; items PAID → operating or financing.
questions.kr: IFRS는 선택: '수취' 항목 → 영업 또는 투자; '지급' 항목 → 영업 또는 재무.

questions.stem: For a non-financial company, dividends received on an equity investment are most likely reported on the income statement as:

choices.C: a reduction of cost of sales

questions.explanation: For non-financial companies, interest, dividends and gains on securities are NON-OPERATING (investing income). For financial companies they are operating.
questions.kr: 비금융회사의 이자·배당·증권처분이익 = '영업외'(투자수익). 금융회사는 영업.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, operating activities are best described as:

choices.A: activities normally regarded as operating, left undefined by the standard
choices.B: all transactions not defined as investing or financing
choices.C: activities that generate interest and dividend income

questions.explanation: US GAAP defines operating as the RESIDUAL — everything not investing or financing. Choice A is the IFRS position (no definition; reflect activities normally regarded as operating).
questions.kr: US GAAP: 영업 = '잔여' — 투자·재무가 아닌 모든 거래. A는 IFRS 입장(정의 없음).

questions.stem: A manufacturer reports a large amount of financial income. An analyst should most likely:

choices.A: treat it as recurring core income
choices.B: investigate the reasons for the company's investments in securities

questions.explanation: For a non-financial company, significant financial income warrants further exploration — is it excess cash parked in securities, or strategic stakes? It is not core and may not recur.
questions.kr: 비금융회사의 큰 금융수익은 추가 조사 대상 — 여유현금 운용인가, 전략적 지분인가? 핵심 아님, 반복 안 될 수 있음.

questions.stem: Sales are 4.0m, cost of sales 2.6m and SG&A 0.6m. On a common-size income statement, gross profit and operating profit are closest to:
questions.explanation: Gross profit = (4.0 − 2.6)/4.0 = 1.4/4.0 = 35%. Operating profit = (1.4 − 0.6)/4.0 = 0.8/4.0 = 20%. Choice B shows cost of sales (65%) instead of gross profit.
questions.kr: 매출총이익 = 1.4/4.0 = 35%. 영업이익 = 0.8/4.0 = 20%. B는 매출원가 비율(65%)을 매출총이익으로 착각.

questions.stem: Company X earns operating profit of 1.5m on sales of 10m; Company Y earns 0.4m on sales of 2m. Based on common-size analysis, which is more profitable?

choices.A: X, since its operating profit is larger
choices.B: Y, since its operating margin is higher

questions.explanation: X margin = 15%; Y margin = 20%. Common-size removes size: Y earns $5 more per $100 of sales. Larger dollar profit is the lure.
questions.kr: X 이익률 15%, Y 20%. 공통형은 규모 효과 제거: Y가 매출 100당 5 더 벌음. 큰 금액 이익이 유인.

questions.stem: In common-size analysis, income tax expense is most meaningfully compared with:
questions.explanation: Tax ÷ PRETAX income = the effective tax rate. Most other lines go over revenue, but tax over revenue is not meaningful.
questions.kr: 세금 ÷ '세전이익' = 유효세율. 다른 항목은 매출로 나누지만 세금은 매출 대비가 의미 없음.

questions.stem: Common-size income statements facilitate comparison across companies primarily because they:

choices.A: adjust for differences in accounting standards
choices.B: remove the effect of company size
choices.C: convert all figures to a common currency

questions.explanation: Stating every line as a % of revenue standardizes the statement and removes the effect of SIZE — allowing time-series and cross-sectional comparison.
questions.kr: 모든 항목을 매출 대비 %로 → 규모 효과 제거 → 시계열·횡단면 비교 가능.

questions.stem: In the same industry, Company A has a 70% gross margin and spends heavily on R&D and advertising; Company B has a 25% gross margin and spends on neither. The most likely inference is that:

choices.B: A sells premium, better-branded products while B competes on price
choices.C: A's cost accounting is less conservative

questions.explanation: A's high gross margin plus heavy R&D and advertising suggest technologically superior, better-branded products at premium prices; B sells cheaper products and skips the investment.
questions.kr: A의 높은 매출총이익률 + R&D·광고 대규모 → 기술·브랜드 우위 제품을 프리미엄에 판매. B는 저가 경쟁.

questions.stem: Beginning equity 600; net income 50; dividends 15; shares issued 25; ending equity 672. Other comprehensive income is closest to:
questions.explanation: OCI = End − (Begin + NI − Div + Shares) = 672 − (600 + 50 − 15 + 25) = 672 − 660 = 12. Choice B (37) treats the share issue as OCI; choice C (−3) drops the dividend.
questions.kr: OCI = 기말 − (기초 + 순이익 − 배당 + 신주) = 672 − 660 = 12. B(37)는 신주발행을 OCI로 처리, C(−3)는 배당 누락.

questions.stem: Which of the following is LEAST likely an item of other comprehensive income?

choices.A: Foreign currency translation adjustments on a foreign subsidiary
choices.B: A gain on the sale of surplus equipment
choices.C: Unrealized gains on available-for-sale debt securities

questions.explanation: Least-likely → T/F each. FX translation (T, OCI). AFS debt unrealized gains (T, OCI). A realized gain on selling equipment is outside ordinary activities but IS in net income (F → answer).
questions.kr: least likely → T/F. 외화환산(T, OCI). 매도가능 채무증권 미실현이익(T, OCI). 설비 처분이익은 비경상이지만 '순이익'에 포함(F → 정답).

questions.stem: Unrealized gains on debt securities the company intends to hold to maturity are most likely:

choices.C: not reported, since the securities are carried at amortised cost

questions.explanation: Held-to-maturity debt is carried at AMORTISED COST, so no unrealized gains or losses are reported anywhere — neither net income nor OCI.
questions.kr: 만기보유 채무증권은 '상각후원가' → 미실현손익을 어디에도 보고하지 않음(순이익도 OCI도 아님).

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, unrealized gains on an equity investment that does not confer significant influence are reported in:
questions.explanation: US GAAP: ALL such equity investments go through the income statement — there is no equity-at-OCI option. IFRS allows an irrevocable FVOCI election.
questions.kr: US GAAP: 이런 지분투자는 '전부' 손익계산서 — OCI 옵션 없음. IFRS는 FVOCI 취소불능 선택 허용.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, an equity investment for which the company makes an irrevocable election at initial recognition to report gains in OCI is measured at:

choices.B: fair value through profit or loss
choices.C: fair value through other comprehensive income

questions.explanation: Irrevocable election at initial recognition → FVOCI. Without the election, IFRS equity investments are FVPL.
questions.kr: 최초 인식 시 취소불능 선택 → FVOCI. 선택하지 않으면 IFRS 지분투자는 FVPL.

questions.stem: A stock trades at $40 with EPS of $2.00. The company reported an OCI loss of $4.5m and has 15m shares. Its price-to-comprehensive-EPS ratio is closest to:
questions.explanation: OCI per share = −4.5 / 15 = −0.30. Comprehensive EPS = 2.00 − 0.30 = 1.70. Ratio = 40 / 1.70 = 23.5×. Choice C adds the OCI loss (2.30) — sign it first; choice A is the plain P/E.

questions.stem: A gain on the sale of surplus land is most likely:

choices.A: other comprehensive income, since it is outside ordinary activities
choices.B: part of net income, even though it is outside ordinary activities
choices.C: excluded from both net income and comprehensive income

questions.explanation: 'Outside ordinary activities' describes GAINS — which are reported IN net income. OCI is defined by where it is reported (equity ↑, net income unchanged), not by activity type.
questions.kr: '통상활동 밖'은 '차익(gain)'의 설명 — 순이익에 '포함'. OCI는 활동 종류가 아니라 보고 위치(자본 ↑, 순이익 불변)로 정의.

questions.stem: An asset costs 10,000 with a residual value of 1,500 and a 3-year life. Under double-declining balance, year-2 depreciation is closest to:
questions.explanation: Rate = 2/3 = 66.7%. Year 1: 66.7% × 10,000 = 6,667 → NBV 3,333. Year 2 mechanically 66.7% × 3,333 = 2,222 would take NBV to 1,111 < 1,500 floor → cap at 3,333 − 1,500 = 1,833. Choice A overshoots the floor; choice C applies the rate to cost − residual.
questions.kr: 율 = 2/3. 1년차 6,667 → NBV 3,333. 2년차 기계적으로 2,222면 NBV 1,111 < 잔존가치 1,500 → 3,333 − 1,500 = 1,833으로 제한. A는 하한 초과, C는 (원가 − 잔존가치)에 적용.

questions.stem: A software company receives a full year's subscription fee in advance. At the date of receipt it should record:
questions.explanation: Cash before delivery → a LIABILITY (contract liability / unearned revenue); revenue is recognized as the service is delivered over the year.
questions.kr: 인도 전 현금 수령 → '부채'(계약부채·선수수익); 서비스 제공에 따라 1년에 걸쳐 수익 인식.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, dividends paid may be classified in the cash flow statement as:
questions.explanation: IFRS: PAID items → operating or financing; RECEIVED items → operating or investing. 'Financing only' is the US GAAP answer.
questions.kr: IFRS: '지급' → 영업 또는 재무; '수취' → 영업 또는 투자. '재무만'은 US GAAP 답.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the four types of OCI items common to IFRS and US GAAP?

choices.A: Certain costs of defined-benefit pension plans
choices.B: Unrealized gains on derivatives accounted for as hedges
choices.C: Unrealized gains on debt securities designated as trading

questions.explanation: F-H-S-P: FX translation, Hedges, certain Securities (AFS / FVOCI), Pensions. TRADING securities' gains go to net income, not OCI.
questions.kr: F-H-S-P: 외화환산·위험회피 파생·일부 증권(매도가능/FVOCI)·연금. '단기매매' 증권 손익은 순이익, OCI 아님.

questions.stem: A trademark with an indefinite useful life is most likely:

choices.A: amortised straight-line with no residual value
choices.B: not amortised, but tested at least annually for impairment
choices.C: depreciated using the diminishing balance method

questions.explanation: Indefinite-life intangibles (and goodwill) are NOT amortised; they are tested for impairment at least annually. Finite-life intangibles are amortised, usually straight-line with no residual.
questions.kr: 무한 내용연수 무형자산(과 영업권)은 상각 안 함, 최소 매년 손상검사. 유한 무형자산은 보통 정액·잔존가치 0으로 상각.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, unrealized gains on available-for-sale debt securities are:

choices.A: excluded from both net income and comprehensive income
choices.B: excluded from net income but included in comprehensive income

questions.explanation: AFS gains go to OCI → excluded from net income but INCLUDED in comprehensive income (CI = NI + OCI).
questions.kr: 매도가능 이익 → OCI → 순이익에서는 제외, 포괄이익에는 '포함'(CI = NI + OCI).

questions.concept: Ex3 Q1 — OCI back-solve with dividends
questions.stem: A company starts the year with equity of €200m, earns net income of €20m, pays €3m of dividends, and has no share transactions. Year-end equity is €227m. The amount that bypassed net income as OCI is closest to:
questions.explanation: OCI = End − (Begin + NI − Div) = 227 − (200 + 20 − 3) = 227 − 217 = €10m. €7m comes from dropping the dividend (227 − 220). Fill all four bracket slots before subtracting.
questions.kr: OCI = 기말 − (기초 + 순이익 − 배당) = 227 − 217 = 10. 7은 배당 누락(227 − 220). 괄호 네 칸을 다 채운 뒤 빼기.

questions.stem: Other comprehensive income is best described as income that:

choices.A: has not yet been realized in cash
choices.B: increases shareholders' equity but is not reflected in net income
choices.C: arises from activities outside the company's ordinary business

questions.explanation: OCI is defined by WHERE it is reported: it raises equity but bypasses net income. 'Outside ordinary activities' describes gains and losses, which ARE in net income; 'not realized in cash' describes accruals generally. Neither says where the item is reported.
questions.kr: OCI는 '보고 위치'로 정의: 자본은 늘리지만 순이익을 거치지 않음. '통상활동 밖'은 차손익(순이익에 포함)의 설명, '현금 미실현'은 발생주의 일반. 둘 다 보고 위치를 말하지 않음.

questions.stem: Under IAS 1, expenses on the income statement can be grouped:
questions.explanation: IAS 1 allows expenses to be presented by NATURE (what they are) or by FUNCTION (what they are for). Either is acceptable.
questions.kr: IAS 1은 성격별 또는 기능별 표시 모두 허용.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an expense classified by function?
questions.explanation: Cost of goods sold groups costs by what they are FOR (producing the goods sold) — a functional classification. Tax and interest expense describe the nature of the cost.
questions.kr: 매출원가는 '무엇을 위한' 비용인지로 묶음 → 기능별. 법인세·이자비용은 성격별.

questions.stem: A manufacturer reports revenue $5.0m, cost of goods sold $3.5m, other operating expenses $0.8m, interest expense $0.2m and tax expense $0.15m. Gross profit is:
questions.explanation: Gross profit = revenue − COGS = 5.0 − 3.5 = $1.5m — the FIRST subtotal. Choice B (0.70) subtracts operating expenses too: that is OPERATING profit. Choice A goes all the way to net income. Name the subtotal, then stop subtracting.
questions.kr: 매출총이익 = 매출 − 매출원가 = 1.5m — '첫 번째' 소계. B(0.70)는 영업비용까지 뺀 영업이익, A는 순이익. 소계 이름을 정하고 거기서 멈추기.

questions.stem: Which statement about a common-size income statement is most accurate? It:

choices.A: expresses each line item as a percentage of net income
choices.B: removes the effect of size, enabling cross-sectional comparison
choices.C: standardizes each line but does not help reveal differences in strategy

questions.explanation: Every line is a % of REVENUE (not net income), which removes size and supports time-series and cross-sectional analysis. The standardization is exactly what REVEALS strategy differences (A's 70% gross margin + R&D/advertising vs B's 25% price competition) — so C's second clause is false.
questions.kr: 모든 항목을 '매출' 대비 %로(순이익 X) → 규모 제거 → 시계열·횡단면 비교. 표준화 덕분에 '전략 차이'가 드러남(A의 70% 매출총이익 + R&D/광고 vs B의 저가) → C의 후반부가 거짓.

questions.stem: Beginning equity 300; ending equity 314; net income 12; dividends 2; unrealized gain on AFS securities 6; unrealized loss on hedging derivatives 4; FX translation gain 2. Which is correct?
questions.explanation: OCI = 6 − 4 + 2 = 4 (the hedge item is a LOSS, so it reduces OCI — C is false). Cross-check with the roll-forward: comprehensive income = (314 − 300) + 2 dividends = 16 = NI 12 + OCI 4. Choice A (14) is the raw change in equity — it forgets to add back the dividend.
questions.kr: OCI = 6 − 4 + 2 = 4(위험회피 항목은 '손실' → OCI 감소, C 거짓). 검산: 포괄이익 = (314 − 300) + 배당 2 = 16 = 순이익 12 + OCI 4. A(14)는 자본 변동만 — 배당을 더하지 않음.

questions.concept: Official Q6 — which item is OCI
questions.stem: Which item is most likely reported in other comprehensive income?

choices.A: A translation adjustment from consolidating a foreign subsidiary
choices.B: An unrealized gain on a trading security
choices.C: A realized gain on a derivative not designated as a hedge

questions.explanation: F-H-S-P: FX translation is OCI. Trading securities → net income. A derivative NOT accounted for as a hedge → net income; and a REALIZED gain is never OCI. The hedge type in OCI needs both qualifiers: unrealized AND accounted for as a hedge.
questions.kr: F-H-S-P: 외화환산 = OCI. 단기매매 증권 → 순이익. 위험회피로 회계처리하지 '않은' 파생 → 순이익, '실현'이익은 OCI가 될 수 없음. OCI의 H는 '미실현' + '위험회피 회계' 두 조건 모두 필요.

questions.front: The five steps of revenue recognition (in order), what each governs, the 'probable' threshold and the distinct test
questions.back:
1 Identify CONTRACT (commercial substance; collectability probable) → 2 identify distinct PERFORMANCE OBLIGATIONS → 3 determine TRANSACTION PRICE → 4 ALLOCATE price → 5 RECOGNIZE when/as satisfied.
3–4 = AMOUNT; 5 = TIMING.
Probable: IFRS = more likely than not; US GAAP = likely to occur (higher bar).
Distinct = benefit on its own/with readily available resources AND separately identifiable.
Contract asset (obligations remain) | receivable (only payment left) | contract liability (cash first).

questions.front: Cost-to-cost revenue, variable consideration, cumulative catch-up, principal vs agent
questions.back:
Progress = costs to date ÷ total expected costs; revenue = progress × PRICE (420/700 = 60% × 1m = 600k).
Variable consideration: include only if cumulative revenue won't be reversed.
Modification (not a new contract unless distinct new goods) → CATCH-UP: new price 1.35m, new costs 820k, 420/820 = 51.2% → 691,200 − 600,000 = 91,200 at once.
Agent (not primarily responsible, no inventory risk, no credit risk, no price discretion) → NET commission; principal → GROSS.

questions.front: SL and DDB formulas, the residual floor, IFRS vs US GAAP differences, non-allocated assets
questions.back:
SL = (Cost − Residual) / Life. Longer life or higher residual → lower expense → higher NI.
DDB rate = 2 × (1/Life), applied to NBV (NOT cost − residual); stop at residual (cap final year).
Accelerated → lower early NI, same total (conservative).
IFRS only: revaluation model; IFRS requires component depreciation + annual review.
Not allocated: land; goodwill and indefinite-life intangibles (annual impairment test).

questions.front: Interest and dividends, received and paid — IFRS vs US GAAP
questions.back:
US GAAP: interest received, dividends received, interest PAID → OPERATING; dividends PAID → FINANCING.
IFRS: received → operating OR investing; paid → operating OR financing.
Income statement (non-financial co.): interest/dividend income and interest expense = non-operating.

questions.front: Doubtful accounts and warranties under the matching principle
questions.back:
Expense in the same period as the revenue it helps generate.
Bad debts: estimate at sale from experience (% of sales / receivables / overdue) as an EXPENSE (not a revenue reduction). Direct write-off = not GAAP.
Warranties: estimate at sale, expense in period of sale, adjust over warranty life for actual experience.

questions.front: OCI formula, the four OCI types, and where unrealized securities gains go
questions.back:
OCI = End − (Begin + NI − Div ± Shares).
F-H-S-P: FX translation | hedge derivatives | certain securities (US GAAP AFS debt; IFRS FVOCI, incl. equity by election) | defined-benefit pension costs.
HTM debt → amortised cost → no unrealized gain anywhere.
US GAAP: trading debt + ALL equity → NI; AFS debt → OCI.
IFRS: FVPL → NI; FVOCI (collect AND sell debt; elected equity) → OCI.
Comprehensive EPS = EPS + OCI/shares.

questions.front: Nature vs function; single vs multi-step; operating profit vs EBIT; common-size tax line
questions.back:
By NATURE = what it is (one depreciation line). By FUNCTION = what it's for (COGS).
MULTI-STEP = gross profit line; SINGLE-STEP = none.
Operating profit before interest (non-financial); financial cos treat interest as operating. Operating profit ≠ EBIT necessarily (associates, discontinued ops).
Common-size: line ÷ revenue; TAX ÷ PRETAX income.
Gain on disposal = proceeds − carrying value.
